programme.desc: 1976. Drama. Director: George P Cosmatos. Stars Sophia Loren, Richard Harris, Burt Lancaster & Martin Sheen. Passengers of a European train can't escape after a deadly virus is planted.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is here to embark on a journey of terror with you tonight. First up, is the 1996 supernatural horror Amityville: Dollhouse, where evil lurks in a young girl's doll house.

programme.title: Amityville: Dollhouse
programme.desc: 1996. Horror. Director: Steve White. Stars Robin Thomas, Starr Andreeff & Allen Cutler. A girl inadvertently releases evil spirits lurking within her toy house, which wreak havoc upon her family.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: We venture into the paranormal in Caroline Munro's next offering - 100 Years of Horror. This documentary, presented by the legendary Christopher Lee, explores the history of classic horror films.

programme.title: 100 Years of Horror
programme.desc: 1998. Documentary. Directed by Ted Newson. King of Horror, Christopher Lee, takes us on a frightening journey from the earliest horror movies to modern day slashers!

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is joined by otherworldly beings, as she takes a look at next week's thrilling films.

programme.title: Battle Beyond The Sun
programme.desc: 1962. Sci-fi. Directed by Mikhail Karyukov, Aleksandr Kozyr & Francis Ford Coppola. Stars Edd Perry & Arla Powell. In the distant future, two rival nations race to be the first to land on Mars.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Mr Acker Bilk and his Paramount Jazz Band perform the fantastic 1962 song Gotta See Baby Tonight.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Clampett Look. 1963. Stars Donna Douglas, Joanna Barnes, Doris Packer. The Clampetts prepare for Mrs. Fenwick and Cynthia to visit, with Cynthia making her mother dress in the 'Clampett Look'.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Big Gun. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Look At Life Meet the Mayor
programme.desc: 1961. A visit to the Lord Mayor's Show in London and an interesting look at the office of the Mayor in Britain.

programme.title: Design for Loving
programme.desc: 1962. Comedy. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars June Thorburn, Pete Murray & Soraya Rafat. Barbara Winters hires beatnik Stanford as her chief fashion adviser which leads to comedic complications.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Sheep Farming/Centenarian Angler. 1981. It's ramming time at the sheep farm, while on the river Frome in Dorset, angler George Dunton attempts to catch a fish on his hundredth birthday.

programme.title: Something in the City
programme.desc: 1950. Comedy. Director: Maclean Rogers. Stars: Richard Hearne, Garry Marsh, Ellen Pollock. A wonderfully simple story of Mr Ningle, who lost his job in the City many years ago.

programme.title: A Lifetime Ago with The Baim Collection
programme.desc: Between Those Four Walls. A nostalgic reminder of 1962 interior home decoration overloaded with facts and figures, with an insight into paper, manufacture and wallpaper design.

programme.title: Rumpole of the Bailey
programme.desc: Rumpole and the Honourable Member. Stars: Leo McKern, Peggy Thorpe-Bates & David Yelland. An MP is accused of a serious crime and is reluctant to defend himself.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Background. 1974. Stars John Slater, Hilda Barry & Gary Fearns. Betty lives in a condemned house and the kids cause trouble for her; except her grandson, Keith; and even he's heading for trouble.

programme.title: Strictly For The Birds
programme.desc: 1963. Comedy. Director Vernon Sewell. Stars Tony Tanner, Joan Sims and Graham Stark. After a fortunate gambling win, Terry Blessing's luck runs out when an ex-girlfriend shows up with a surprise.

programme.title: Look At Life Glamour Girls
programme.desc: 1960. Dive into the glamorous world of the fashion model from all angles, see them at work and some of them at play. Includes a look at the model school, model agent and different types of models.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: The Mole. 1976. Stars Richard Easton, Robin Chadwick & Clive Swift. Griffith Trevelyan, Chief Sales Executive of RAI Transport, decides to play games with the rival companies bidding for his firm.

programme.title: Scarlet Thread
programme.desc: 1951. Crime drama directed by Lewis Gilbert and starring Kathleen Byron, Laurence Harvey and Sydney Tafler. Two high flying crooks take part in a robbery that goes very wrong.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: 1955. Crime. Director: Ken Hughes. Stars Sydney Chaplin, Audrey Dalton & Jefferson Clifford. After several killings of thieves occur, a priest is then marked for murder after hearing a confession.

programme.title: Strange But True
programme.desc: Life Beyond Death/The Haunted Bomber. 1996. Michael Aspel explores near death experiences and what may lie beyond, and visits Cosford in Shropshire to consider the mystery of the haunted bomber.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1954. The Dark Stairway. Director: Ken Hughes. Stars Vincent Ball & George Manship. A blind man who is witness to a murder on a darkened stairway, is asked to identify the killer. (S1, E05)

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Wolf. Stars Barry Foster, Joanna Dunham & Nigel Stock. When the murdered body of a young man is discovered in his bed, Van der Valk must ask, why are there so many clues?

programme.title: Maxwell
programme.desc: 2007. Drama. Director: Colin Barr. Stars David Suchet, Patricia Hodge & Ben Caplan. The final two months of the life of media tycoon Robert Maxwell, as his life is on the brink of collapse.

programme.title: Hot Money
